meta.name: add-resend
meta.description: Add Resend (email) channel integration via Chat SDK.

copy.tagline: 集成 Resend 邮件发送通道到聊天应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在聊天应用中添加邮件发送能力
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Resend email channel into your chat app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add email sending to a chat application

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会把 Resend 邮件渠道接入 NanoClaw：复制并注册邮件适配器、安装固定版本的依赖包、运行构建和测试；然后引导你填写 Resend 的 API 密钥等凭据，最后把你的邮箱设为所有者并发一封欢迎邮件。
howto.when: 当你说出“添加 Resend”、“集成邮件”等请求，或要求给 NanoClaw 接上邮件渠道时触发。

say.text: 帮我把 NanoClaw 接入 Resend 邮箱
添加 Resend 邮件渠道
say.note: 它会复制适配器、注册并运行构建和测试。

say.text: 配置 Resend 并给我的邮箱发封测试邮件
say.note: 会引导你填凭据，并把你的地址设为所有者。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude wires Resend email into NanoClaw: copies/registers adapter, installs pinned dep, runs build & tests, prompts for and stores credentials, then sets your email as owner and sends a hello email.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to add Resend, integrate email, or connect NanoClaw to an email channel.

say_en.text: Connect NanoClaw to Resend email for me.
say_en.note: Claude runs the skill and prompts for credentials.
It copies, registers, builds, and tests.

say_en.text: Set up Resend and send me a test email.
say_en.note: Prompts for credentials and wires you as owner.
